up: List the IC50 (nM) activity values for compounds tested against human P2X7 purinoceptor (CHEMBL4805) that have a SMILES string and a PubMed ID or DOI, showing the compound's ChEMBL ID, SMILES, key, assay description, exact potency value and units, any comment, and the PubMed ID or DOI.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_value AS potency_value,
  a.standard_units AS potency_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4805'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND (d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL OR d.doi IS NOT NULL);
